correctness.rationale: Reconstructed equivariant adjunction K_C=O_C(d-2), trivial determinant character, Koszul/trace-free SO(3) harmonic representation ⊕_{ell=0}^{d-2}H_ell; independently evaluated rotation-order character vectors A4(4,0,1,1), S4(9,1,1,0,1), A5(25,1,1,0,0) and checked group-algebra factor dimensions sum to genera 4,9,25. Cyclic subgroup invariant dimensions and tame Riemann–Hurwitz yield exactly 6,8,12 ramification points, equal one |G|/m orbit; finite cyclic stabilizers justify disjointness. This is uniform over smooth parameters, not numerical sampling. The proof asserts only C-isogeny and does not certify factor simplicity.

originality.rationale: Gegelia–van Straten establish the Platonic families, genera and elliptic rotation-group quotient. Paulhus–Rojas and Reyes-Carocca–Rodríguez provide general Jacobian group-algebra techniques. Their inspected material does not specify these three canonical character decompositions, corresponding low-dimensional isogeny factors, or unique ramification signatures for this named complete-intersection family. General representation methods are acknowledged; new work is their explicit nontrivial application to all smooth members.
